text:
Ana: Quick sync — planning a phased SI onramp dryrun + announcement window for H100/H200, B200, MI300, and Gaudi. Need to lock embargo windows and compatibility signoffs.
Mike: timeline check — lab can validate H200 + B200 next week but MI300 Gaudi kernel work needs 2 more weeks.
Supriya: confirm lab capacity: we can run 3 dryruns Tue/Wed/Thu if images are ready by Monday EOD.
Jon: who's owning the marketplace SKU gating and press embargo? need single owner for handoff.
Ana: @Lisa can you own press embargo timing? we'll map marketplace slots to embargo windows.
Lisa: can do. prefer 2-week preannounce window for enterprise partners, shorter for PLG. will coordinate embargo list and NDA recipients.
Mike: blocking: MI300 driver 55.3 has a regression with KV cache on our quant kernels. patch in review, ETA Wed. until patched we should mark MI300 as "limited" for the announcement.
Supriya: lab note — for Gaudi we need the new docker image tag: redwood/gaudi:onramp-2026-03-02. please publish the image and test plan in the repo.
Ana: note for SI integrations: require sample workload + perf profiles. can we get a lightweight perf harness? small script is fine.
Jon: I'll own the perf harness. will push a small runner and smoke tests: run/perf/run.sh + output meta. will include latency/throughput baseline.
Mike: for marketplace gating add compatibility matrix row: kernel, driver, image-tag, firmware, notes. I'll fill H100/H200/B200. Supriya fill Gaudi/MI300.
Supriya: will update matrix by Tue morning. also adding acceptance criteria: no token loss, <5% regression vs baseline.
Ana: action items recap: Lisa press embargo owner, Jon perf harness, Mike drivers/matrix H100-H200-B200, Supriya Gaudi/MI300 images + matrix. target dryrun start Tue next week.
Lisa: I'll draft press timeline and embargo list today, will post doc link. prefer to keep SI logos out of preannounce until partners sign agreement.
deploy-bot: CI: onramp-image-build succeeded (tag: redwood/gaudi:onramp-2026-03-02) :white_check_mark:
Mike: thanks deploy-bot — I'll kick off kernel tests now and post failures in this thread.
Supriya: one more — request for SI: please provide contact for firmware/BIOS testing, some partners need vendor-level access. ping me privately if sensitive.
Ana: great progress. next sync Thu 10am PT to review dryrun results and finalize announcement wave. if anything blocks earlier call out ASAP. :thumbsup:
